div.div:
SecurityFilterChain
[Component: @Bean in SecurityConfig]
CSRF: disabled (stateless REST)
Session: STATELESS
Public (permitAll):
POST /api/v1/auth/**
GET /api/v1/events/**
GET /api/v1/venues/**
All others: authenticated
Auth: HTTP Basic

div.div:
BCryptPasswordEncoder
[Component: @Bean in SecurityConfig]
One-way hash for passwords.
Used by UserService.register()
and Spring Security auth.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 378px; height: 1px; padding-top: 391px; margin-left: 332px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0px; text-align: center;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: rgb(255, 255, 255); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: normal;

div.div:
UserService
[Component: @Service — implements UserDetailsService]
register() — creates user, encodes password
with BCrypt, assigns ROLE_CUSTOMER
loadUserByUsername(email) — Spring Security
callback. Returns UserDetails with email,
password hash, enabled, and granted authority
"ROLE_" + role (CUSTOMER|ORGANIZER|ADMIN)
findById() · findEntityByEmail()

div.div:
GlobalExceptionHandler
[Component: @RestControllerAdvice]
ResourceNotFoundException → 404
BusinessRuleException → 422
DuplicatePurchaseException → 409
InsufficientTicketsException → 409
MethodArgumentNotValidException → 400
AccessDeniedException → 403
Exception (catch-all) → 500
All errors → ApiResponse<Void>
